description:
From IMDB: "Azra is worlds apart from her conservative Muslim mother. Following a tragedy, Azra finds herself on a Bollywood-inspired journey to Pakistan - guided by memories of her mother's youth in Karachi and her own coming-of-age in rural Canada." Starring the fantastic Amrit Kaur.

Huzzah provided a number of shots, including screen replacement and a number of paint outs.
